edits.walkthrough_append: **Distinguish the authority types in order:** 1. Formal authority — written, documented, position-based; its origin is legal (Companies Act 2013 empowers boards). 2. Acceptance authority — exists only when subordinates choose to comply. 3. Competence authority — flows from expertise (the architect over the legal director in technical decisions). 4. Test any case by asking: documented, accepted, or expert? **EXAM TRAP:** Formal and acceptance authority can conflict — a legally valid order may still be ineffective if subordinates withhold acceptance; writing that legality alone guarantees obedience collapses Barnard's distinction and loses the comparison mark.
